tool.name: RhizAeon
tool.description: detect recombination in a nucleotide alignment
tool.command:
## The engine falls back to the *staged* filename (dataset_NNNN.dat) when no ## title is given, which is meaningless to the user. Derive a sensible default ## from the history element name instead. #set $title_value = str($title) if str($title) else str($input_file.element_identifier)
rhizaeon --input '$input_file' --output '$summary_json' #if $outputs_section.emit_viz --viz '$viz_json' #end if #if $outputs_section.emit_html --html '$report_html' #end if --title '$title_value' --landmarks $advanced.landmarks --alpha $advanced.alpha --poisson-floor $advanced.poisson_floor --tier2-stringency $advanced.tier2_stringency --tier3-stringency $advanced.tier3_stringency #if $advanced.snp_compression == 'on' --compress-snps #elif $advanced.snp_compression == 'off' --no-compress-snps #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Nucleotide alignment
param.help: Aligned nucleotide sequences in FASTA format. All sequences must be the same length.

param.label: Report title
param.help: Title used in the visualization JSON and the HTML dashboard. Defaults to the name of the input dataset.

validator.message: Please use only letters, digits, spaces and basic punctuation

param.name: emit_viz
param.label: Write visualization JSON
param.help: Rich JSON dossier consumed by the HTML dashboard

param.label: Landmarks (K)
param.help: Number of landmarks placed on the manifold

param.label: Significance level (alpha)
param.help: Family-wise significance level used for event calling

param.label: Poisson floor
param.help: Minimum number of supporting informative sites for a candidate tract

param.label: Tier-2 stringency
param.help: Multiplier on the trajectory and donor-attribution gate. Values above 1 are stricter, below 1 more permissive.

param.label: Tier-3 stringency
param.help: Multiplier on the sequence and topological due-diligence gate. Values above 1 are stricter, below 1 more permissive.

param.name: snp_compression
param.label: SNP compression
param.help: Collapse invariant columns before scanning. In auto mode compression is enabled when the alignment is longer than 30 kb, has 48 or more taxa, or has more than 600k cells.

tool.help:
**What it does**
RhizAeon detects recombination (mosaic sequence tracts) in a nucleotide alignment without reconstructing a guide tree. Instead of enumerating all O(N^3) sequence triplets like 3SEQ or RDP, it projects the alignment onto a continuous metric manifold using prefix distance tensors and deconvolves candidate breakpoints with a physical attention force field. Runtime scales linearly with cohort size, and multi-parent mosaics (3+ parents) and introgression from unsampled "ghost" lineages are resolved natively.
-----
**Input**
A FASTA file containing a nucleotide alignment. All sequences must be aligned to the same length; ragged alignments are rejected. Gapped alignments are accepted as-is — RhizAeon does not impute or alter gaps. Ambiguity codes are treated as missing data.
Compressed (`.fasta.gz`) input is not supported by the engine. Decompress the dataset first (for example with **Convert Formats → gzip** or by uploading the uncompressed file).
-----
**Outputs**
- **Summary JSON** (always) — run metadata, informative site count, screening results, and one record per detected event with the recombinant (`candidate_name`), the parental context (`home_name`), the donor (`donor_name`), a ghost-donor flag, breakpoint coordinates (`u1`, `u2`), `tract_length`, the Fisher p-value (`p_fisher`) and the physical z-score (`z_phys`). An empty `events` list with `"is_non_recombinant_h0": true` means the alignment was certified non-recombinant under the H0 null. - **Visualization JSON** (optional) — the dossier consumed by the HTML report, including per-taxon mosaic segments, breakpoints, manifold coordinates and the recombination landscape. - **HTML report** (optional) — a standalone, self-contained dashboard that can be opened directly in a browser.
-----
**Options**
- **Report title** — shown in the visualization JSON and the HTML dashboard. If left blank, the name of the input dataset is used. - **Landmarks** (`--landmarks`, default 16) — number of landmarks K placed on the manifold. - **Alpha** (`--alpha`, default 0.05) — family-wise significance level for event calling. - **Poisson floor** (`--poisson-floor`, default 3) — minimum number of supporting informative sites for a candidate tract. - **Tier-2 / Tier-3 stringency** (default 1.0) — multipliers on the successive validation gates (trajectory and donor attribution; sequence and topological due diligence). Raise them to reduce false positives, lower them to increase sensitivity. - **SNP compression** — collapses invariant columns to speed up large alignments. In `Automatic` mode it is enabled when the alignment is longer than 30 kb, has 48 or more taxa, or has more than 600k cells.
-----
**Notes**
RhizAeon is single-threaded; there is no thread setting. The tool runs fully offline and does not download any model weights.
